evidence.claim: Symbotic's investor-relations SEC filing index lists accession 0001932967-26-000007 as a Form 4 filed September 14, 2026 and exposes HTML/PDF/RTF/XLS filing artifacts.

The reproduced Form 4 identifies David A. Ladensohn as a 10% owner and states that on September 10, 2026 The Tilia Mill Trust distributed 200,000 Class V-1 shares and an equal number of paired Symbotic Holdings Units to the trust beneficiary; Ladensohn disclaims beneficial ownership. The reproduced filing footnotes characterize the movement as a trust distribution rather than an open-market trade.

The filing table resolves four paired economic movements: two 200,000-unit/share trust distributions and two bona fide gifts of 231,896 and 373,896 units/shares. It reports no market price/value for the Holdings Units and $0.00 for the paired Class V shares. Post-transaction indirect holdings shown include 10,790,532 Holdings Units for Serenade QSST Trust, 14,178,979 for Tilia Mill Trust, 231,896 for PLC 2023 Receptacle Trust, 373,896 for RCK 2024 Receptacle Trust, and 151,561,831 for RBC Millennium Trust, with paired Class V holdings also reported.

Independent Form 4 parsing classifies the 200,000-share decreases with transaction code J and the 231,896- and 373,896-share increases with transaction code G, all without sale proceeds; paired rows appear because both Symbotic Holdings Units and corresponding Class V shares moved.

resolution.beneficialOwnershipCaveat: The filing states Ladensohn disclaims beneficial ownership of the trust-held securities; the movements are trust-level distributions/gifts and should not be interpreted as discretionary open-market insider buying or selling.
resolution.evidenceVsInference: The transaction codes/amounts and trust-transfer substance are evidence from faithful filing reproductions corroborated by independent structured parsing. The conclusion that this is not an open-market conviction signal is inference directly implied by codes J/G, zero/no price, and the filing footnotes.
resolution.gateImpact: The exact SYM freshness blocker described in t0-bootstrap-queue is resolved. No evidence supports treating this accession as an open-market sale/purchase or as a price-bearing dilution event.
